title: Last Bell, 2004
logline: School lets out. The garage is two blocks from the school now. He hears the bell through the wall and draws it.

panels.composition: The garage, 3:05 PM. WOOD at the table. Through the casement window, the bell — drawn as a jagged shape coming in over the tavern roof.

image.prompt: a garage studio at 3:05 PM with a jagged bell-sound shape drawn coming through the small window over a tavern roof, a man drawing, a dog with one ear up, muddy flats

panels.composition: Wood not looking up. Drawing the bell.

image.prompt: a man drawing the jagged shape of a bell sound on a pad without looking up

panels.composition: Through the window: kids on the sidewalk, released, walking past the tavern toward the beach, none of them his.

image.prompt: through a small casement window, teenagers walking past a tavern toward a beach on the last day of school, none of them looking at the garage

panels.composition: The garage. Wood. The bell shape on the pad. The dog. He doesn't drive past this year. He draws it from two blocks away.

image.prompt: a man at a drafting table with a drawing of a bell sound on his pad, a dog under the table, afternoon light, no words

art.line: brush-pen scanned; muddy digital flats; Sundays in watercolor, improving
art.palette: limited, muddy; Sundays gray-green, rust, one warm
